sample_positive_negative_bboxes: sample positive and negative bounding boxes from assign results using MultiInsRandomSampler for multi instance detection
sample_positive_instances: sample positive instances from assign results by selecting indices where labels are greater than zero
sample_negative_instances: sample negative instances from assign results by selecting indices where labels equal zero
create_multi_instance_sampler: create a MultiInsRandomSampler registered under TASK_UTILS for predicting multiple detection boxes from one proposal
review_sampling_result: review the MultiInstanceSamplingResult containing pos_inds, neg_inds, priors, gt_and_ignore_bboxes, and gt_flags
